snippet.title: Sky Flowers // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4872090/Sky_Flowers

SKY FLOWERS is a platform and puzzle game focused in movement mixing 2D and 3D ambients. You will have to navigate the interiors of the statue that hides lost treasure and uncover the mysteries behind the reason of why you are trapped in this place.

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: ButterSprite
📚 Publisher: ButterSprite
📅 Release Date: Coming soon
🎯 Genre: Adventure, Indie
